description:
【Universal Compatibility】Designed with multiple plug types (US/AU/UK/EU) and a universal socket, compatible with devices from most countries worldwide.
【High Power Capacity】Supports a wide voltage range of 100-240V and up to 1380W power output, safely accommodating devices up to 1000W.
【Safety First】Constructed with flame-retardant PC+ABS material for enhanced safety during use.
【Child Protection】Features a built-in safety shutter to prevent accidental contact by children.
【Travel-Friendly】Compact and versatile design makes it an ideal companion for international business trips and vacations.
